from:
Kavango Solar installs household solar kits in Rundu. It surveyed 250 households out of the 9 000 in its service area, approaching people at a shopping centre on two Saturday mornings; a further 40 of those approached declined to answer. The results were:

| Price of kit | Households saying they would buy |
|---|---|
| N$6 000 | 145 |
| N$7 500 | 90 |
| N$9 000 | 40 |

Calculate the percentage saying they would buy at each price and what the N$7 500 figure implies for the service area; taking the margin of error as about 1 divided by the square root of the sample size, state the range around that figure; and evaluate whether Kavango Solar should set its price at N$7 500 on this evidence.
to:
Kavango Solar installs household solar kits in Rundu. It surveyed 250 households out of the 9 000 in its service area, approaching people at a shopping centre on two Saturday mornings; a further 40 of those approached declined to answer. The results were:

| Price of kit | Households saying they would buy |
|---|---|
| N$6 000 | 145 |

why: State is not used on the current AS papers; that part now instructs with Calculate. A data-response task with three parts, so no single paper tariff is claimed.
